purpose: Ask whether conventional atom-only controls contain explanatory information about closed-shell activation versus weak-complex behavior, without adding a molecular energy term.

raw_vector.centre_outer_p_mean_radius_bohr: occupancy-weighted mean radius of neutral centre outermost p channel
raw_vector.ligand_outer_p_mean_radius_bohr: occupancy-weighted mean radius of neutral ligand outermost p channel
raw_vector.centre_outer_p_radial_sigma_bohr: occupancy-weighted radial sigma of neutral centre outermost p channel
raw_vector.ligand_outer_p_radial_sigma_bohr: occupancy-weighted radial sigma of neutral ligand outermost p channel

anti_fit_rules: No scalar score or weighted combination is defined in v0.11.
No threshold is selected from known KrF2/VDW labels.
HF anion attachment gain is a control-model finite difference, not asserted experimental electron affinity.
Charge-transfer margin is not asserted to be a literal 3c4e mechanism.
Any atomic solver quality failure remains visible and invalidates the corresponding vector for quantitative comparison rather than triggering an element-specific rescue.

allowed: inspect raw ordering and Pareto structure
compare with already-known reference classes without calling the comparison blind validation
use failures to design a future preregistered transfer test
forbidden: fit weights to KrF2/NeCl2/NeBr2/ArBr2 labels and report the fitted separator as validation
replace a failed HF anion calculation with experimental affinity for only one ligand
